description: Get one-time links for uploading image FILES from the agent's own machine — for clients that can read local files and send HTTP requests (Claude Code, Cursor, scripts). A chat client passes image links instead, and ChatGPT passes attached files itself through the files field. For each link, send the raw file bytes with HTTP PUT within 15 minutes — for example: curl -X PUT --data-binary @photo.jpg "<uploadUrl>". One file per link; JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB each (a bigger file is refused — there is no resize). The PUT answers JSON with url: pass that url to add_product_images (images[].url), create_content_post (imageUrls), set_category_image or set_brand_image (url), which store their own copy. Creating links changes nothing in the CRM. Returns { uploads: [{ uploadUrl, expiresAt }], maxBytes, allowedTypes }. Needs products:write or content:write.

count.description: How many upload links to create — one per file, at most 10.
